sayLines.line: 🛟 Nancy stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
🤢 Altynai ate raw food — fever by nightfall.
🤒 Emma is sitting up again. Whatever the fever was, it let go.
🤒 Leo is on the mend — the fever broke.
